mapper.sql: field_id, field_code, field_name, field_creator_id, field_create_time, field_updater_id, field_update_time, field_enable
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.field_id, r.field_code, r.field_name, r.field_creator_id, r.field_create_time, r.field_updater_id, r.field_update_time, r.field_enable FROM sys_org_role r INNER JOIN sys_org_role_element re ON r.field_id = re.field_role_id WHERE re.field_element_id IN ( -- 用户自身组织元素 SELECT e.field_id FROM sys_org_element e WHERE e.field_id = #{userId} AND e.field_org_type = 3 UNION -- 用户所属岗位 SELECT pu.field_post_id FROM sys_org_post_user pu WHERE pu.field_user_id = #{userId} UNION -- 用户所属虚拟组织 SELECT vu.field_virtual_id FROM sys_org_virtual_user vu WHERE vu.field_user_id = #{userId} UNION -- 用户直属组织链路上的机构/部门 SELECT anc.field_id FROM sys_org_element anc INNER JOIN sys_org_element u ON u.field_id = #{userId} AND u.field_org_type = 3 WHERE anc.field_org_type IN (1, 2) AND u.field_hierarchy IS NOT NULL AND u.field_hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('%/', anc.field_id, '/%') ) ORDER BY r.field_create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT r.field_id, r.field_name FROM sys_org_role r INNER JOIN sys_org_role_element re ON r.field_id = re.field_role_id WHERE re.field_element_id IN ( -- 用户自身组织元素 SELECT e.field_id FROM sys_org_element e WHERE e.field_id = #{userId} AND e.field_org_type = 3 UNION -- 用户所属岗位 SELECT pu.field_post_id FROM sys_org_post_user pu WHERE pu.field_user_id = #{userId} UNION -- 用户所属虚拟组织 SELECT vu.field_virtual_id FROM sys_org_virtual_user vu WHERE vu.field_user_id = #{userId} UNION -- 用户直属组织链路上的机构/部门 SELECT anc.field_id FROM sys_org_element anc INNER JOIN sys_org_element u ON u.field_id = #{userId} AND u.field_org_type = 3 WHERE anc.field_org_type IN (1, 2) AND u.field_hierarchy IS NOT NULL AND u.field_hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('%/', anc.field_id, '/%') ) ORDER BY r.field_name
SELECT field_element_id FROM sys_org_role_element WHERE field_role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY field_element_id
SELECT field_auth_id FROM sys_org_role_auth WHERE field_role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY field_auth_id

SELECT r.field_id, r.field_code, r.field_name, r.field_creator_id, r.field_create_time, r.field_updater_id, r.field_update_time, r.field_enable FROM sys_org_role r INNER JOIN sys_org_role_element re ON r.field_id = re.field_role_id WHERE re.field_element_id = #{elementId} ORDER BY r.field_create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM sys_org_role
AND field_id = #{model.fieldId} AND field_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model.fieldCode}, '%') AND field_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model.fieldName}, '%') AND field_enable = #{model.fieldEnable}
ORDER BY
field_update_time field_code field_create_time
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{pages.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
